answer: Rewards vest in escrow for a hundred epochs while an audit clusters accounts by answer-fingerprint overlap. Keys written from one template collapse into a family; if any member is confirmed as a copy, the family's whole escrow burns. One lazy submission detonates a thousand siblings' balances, so holding many identities raises the blast radius rather than the payout. Each key must carry its own pigment, a texture a template swap cannot fake. A farm spread across a wide lagoon of cheap keys drains as one body; honest operators cross on a narrow bridge of written work.
